content:
**T-65 Power Armor** is a set of Power Armor in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

A set of power armor utilized by Secret Service in Vault 79. The armor offers the highest physical and energy resistances out of any power armor in the game. It provides the second-highest protection against radiation after the Strangler Heart Power Armor. As with all other bullion-exclusive items, the plans and individual pieces of T-65 power armor are non-tradeable.

On an average build, the difference in damage received while wearing a full T65 Emergency Protocols set versus a full Excavator Emergency Protocols set is about 1-4 points for most PvE enemies. T65 is most valuable for PvP, where incoming damage is much higher. A full set of power armor grants 42% damage reduction and 90% radiation damage reduction.

To purchase the plans for the T-65 power armor, player characters must have completed the quest All That Glitters for the Settlers at Foundation or the quest Secrets Revealed for the raiders at the Crater and have unlocked the Gold Bullion currency system. The plans for the T-65 power armor can then be bought from Regs inside Vault 79.
